Size of epithelial patches in simulation

summary: The page discusses the spatial distribution of cells and virus particles over time in a simulated infection model. Initial infection was set at 5% with a patch size of 0.3 mm x 0.3 mm. The simulation tracked changes in uninfected, infected, and dead cells, as well as extracellular virus over a period of 2 days. Results showed significant differences in cell distribution and virus presence compared to ODE model predictions.
